title: Can we safely choose a Notify catalogue entry?
question: The catalogue has several similarly named notification entries. Which frozen record reports a public-facing endpoint, what do the source-specific licence and access fields say, and what evidence is still needed before reuse or integration?
scope: The real-world API catalogue snapshot is dated 16 July 2026. The separately captured Wayfinder comparison overlay is synthetic and was captured on 24 September 2026.
answer: The GOV.UK API Catalogue row titled GOV.UK Notify is associated with Government Digital Service. Its generated Markdown records https://api.notifications.service.gov.uk/ and documentation at https://www.notifications.service.gov.uk/documentation. It says access model unknown, contract status documentation-only, and licence not specified. Its source row last-modified date is 24 August 2020.

A different GOV.UK API Catalogue row, GOVUK Notify, is associated with the Department for Work and Pensions. Its record has no endpoint URL, records access model unknown and contract status undocumented-in-catalogue, and states an ISC licence with source-declared basis. Its source row last-modified date is 23 August 2022. This record-level licence cannot be transferred to the Government Digital Service entry.

The similarly named Government Notify record from Wayfinder is synthetic comparison material. Its .example endpoint, synthetic authority, synthetic-fixture scope and rights-not-specified state do not describe a live UK government service.
decision: Do not merge the records or infer current availability, security, procurement suitability or licence coverage. Confirm the intended provider and obtain current service documentation, contract and rights evidence before reuse.
reader_boundary: On the pinned Explorer Reader, the publisher panel heading uses the route slug government-digital-service. The source-backed publisher record still contains the human-readable title Government Digital Service; the panel also reports 9 matching catalogue records and shows a GOV.UK Notify preview. Treat this as a Reader label limitation, not missing publisher identity.

sources.label: GOVUK Notify — Department for Work and Pensions

negative_controls: Do not attribute the Department for Work and Pensions ISC field to Government Digital Service.
Do not treat an absent endpoint or unknown access field as proof that no service exists.
Do not admit Wayfinder's fictional endpoint as a live government service or treat its rights as specified.
